channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Bay Open Space Parcel P24
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Bay Open Space Parcel P24 (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Open Space Parcel P24: The name keeps the official parcel code and adds…
item.description: The name keeps the official parcel code and adds the kind of place. No source read gives the parcel a proper name of its own. Shape, status and use are unchanged; the old page address now redirects to the new one, and the old name still finds the record in search. Source: Successor Agency's Long-Range Property Management Plan for Mission Bay, Attachment A, DOF Tracking Sheet for Mission Bay (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/02%20Mission%20Bay.pdf), rows labelled "Park P23", "Park P24", "Park P27".

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Open Space Parcel P24: SocketSite (April 2019) only reports the P23/P24…
item.description: SocketSite (April 2019) only reports the P23/P24 park as expected to be completed by the end of 2019, so the 'under construction' status was removed. OCII's September 2023 deck says the Port 'will manage' P24 rather than already managing it. A citation to our own mapping notes was replaced by the Dec 2019 land use map; the map shape now cites the land use map and the deck, its descriptions drawn from imagery are marked as observations, and the aerial photo caption no longer says 'from a departing flight'. Source: SocketSite, 2019-04-22 (https://socketsite.com/archives/2019/04/mission-bay-is-nearly-built-out-mission-rock-in-the-wings.html); OCII, Mission Bay Parks Open Space (CAC Item 2), 2023-09 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/Item%202%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Transition.pdf); OCII Mission Bay Land Use Map, 2019-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/Att%201%20Mission%20Bay%20Land%20Use%20Map.pdf).
item.source: SocketSite, 2019-04-22 (https://socketsite.com/archives/2019/04/mission-bay-is-nearly-built-out-mission-rock-in-the-wings.html); OCII, Mission Bay Parks Open Space (CAC Item 2), 2023-09 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/Item%202%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Transition.pdf); OCII Mission Bay Land Use Map, 2019-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/Att%201%20Mission%20Bay%20Land%20Use%20Map.pdf)

item.title: Complete · Mission Bay Open Space Parcel P24: OCII's November 14, 2024 CAC update map… (~Nov 2024)
item.description: OCII's November 14, 2024 CAC update map (slide 2, "Mission Bay Parks") points its label "P23 & P24" at a light-green area, the colour its legend gives as "COMPLETED PARK". This is the state shown as of the deck's date, read from the map; the deck gives no completion date and draws no parcel lines for P23/P24 (~Nov 2024). Source: Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (OCII), 2024-11-14.
item.source: Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (OCII), 2024-11-14

item.title: Milestone · Mission Bay Open Space Parcel P24: OCII's Mission Bay Parks Open Space… (~Sep 2023)
item.description: OCII's Mission Bay Parks Open Space transition presentation to the Mission Bay CAC (September 2023) lists P24 among the parcels the Port "will manage", with the open space to transfer "by the end of December 2023" (an expected date), and not among those listed as 'when built'. This is a plan; it does not say the lawn was complete or when it was built (~Sep 2023). Source: Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (sfocii.org), 2023-09.
item.source: Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (sfocii.org), 2023-09

item.title: Milestone · Mission Bay Open Space Parcel P24: SocketSite (April 22, 2019) reports the… (~Apr 2019)
item.description: SocketSite (April 22, 2019) reports the nearly 2-acre 'Mariposa Bayfront Park (P23/P24)' as expected to be completed by the end of 2019; the article does not say construction had started; a 2019 forecast; no source read gives the date the park was finished (~Apr 2019). Source: SocketSite, 2019-04-22.
